newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Krung Thai Bank rated sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Krung Thai Bank rated sell.

text.p: Asset Plus Securities Co Ltd on Wednesday recommended a "sell" on Krung Thai Bank (KTB) shares because it expected the bank not to maintain net interest margin (NIM) at four percent in 1997.

"Average NIM was 4.36 percent in 1996 while NIM in Q4 was 4.0 percent, It is unlikely that KTB will be able to maintain NIM at 4.0 percent in 1997 due to increased weight of non-performing loans and continued tight liquidity," Asset Plus said.
Asset Plus said Krung Thai Bank also adopted a policy of shifting its focus on raising government and state enterprise deposits to mobilising public funds.
It said the three measures would put pressure on Krung Thai Bank's current four percent net interest margin.
"We are then probably looking at a greater than 40 basis points drop in KTB's average NIM in 1997 from the average NIM in 1996," it said.
Krung Thai Bank rose 0.25 baht to 44.75 at 0345 GMT on Wednesday.
